Metadata.description: Starter template to kick off Next.js 16 projects in minutes.

HomePage.title: Kick off your next project in minutes
HomePage.description: A production-ready foundation with everything set up: UI, database, i18n, SEO, testing and code quality. Clone it and start building.
HomePage.stackTitle: Everything you need, already set up
HomePage.stackDescription: Installed with the official CLIs, on their latest stable versions and with no known vulnerabilities.

nextjs.title: Next.js 16
nextjs.description: App Router, Turbopack and React Compiler with React 19.

typescript.title: TypeScript
typescript.description: Strict typing across the project, including environment variables and translations.

ui.title: Tailwind CSS & shadcn/ui
ui.description: Accessible, customizable components, Lucide icons and dark mode.

database.title: Prisma & PostgreSQL
database.description: Typed ORM with migrations and environment variables validated with T3-env.

i18n.title: Internationalization
i18n.description: Locale-based routing with next-intl and typed messages in Spanish and English.

seo.title: SEO
seo.description: Metadata, per-locale Open Graph, sitemap, robots and hreflang.

testing.title: Testing
testing.description: Vitest and Testing Library for unit tests, Playwright for end-to-end.

quality.title: Code quality
quality.description: Biome, Husky, lint-staged and conventional commits on every commit.
